Amendment of section 12; Act IX of 1908

ACT XIII OF 1991
ACT XIII OF 1991
LIMITATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act further to amend the
Limitation Act, 1908
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, 6th July, 1991]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the- President on the 4th
July, 1991, and is hereby published for general information:
2. Amendment of section 12; Act IX of 1908.--In the Limitation Act,
1908 (IX of 1908), in section 12, after subsection (4), the following new
subsection shall be added, namely:--
"(5) For the
purposes of subsections (2), (3) and (4), the time requisite for obtaining a
copy of the decree, sentence, order, judgment or award shall be deemed to be
the time intervening between the day on which an application for the copy is
made and the day actually intimated to the applicant to be the day on which the
copy will be ready for delivery."
